monster.merc_spaceborn_ghosts_male.name: Spaceborn Ghost
monster.merc_tifton_elite_male.desc: An operator forged on the Tifton Proving Grounds (Earth, the south of old Georgia), where the ground has gone glassy from constant heavy-weapon trials.
monster.merc_tifton_elite_male.name: Tifton's Vet
monster.merc_tongkong_female.desc: A training program that deliberately walked away from “the system.” Personality-mod modules, licensed habits, tactical gimmicks — everything is stitched into a bespoke SOF profile, built to order.
monster.merc_tongkong_female.name: Tongkong
monster.merc_tunnel_rats_female.desc: Tunnel Rat conditioning makes graduates instinctively track along service runs and vent trunks. That same instinct drives them to pull maximum salvage with minimum contact: stay in the ducts, stay off the feed, get paid.
monster.merc_tunnel_rats_female.name: Tunnel Rat
monster.merc_unit_317_male.desc: An operator who’s been through Unit 317 stops having a feel for what you “can’t” do under NCE regs. In the end, the urge to run nonconventional tactical protocols outweighs even the self-preservation module.
monster.merc_unit_317_male.name: 317s
monster.merc_valkyrie_squad_female.desc: A Valkyrie Squad medic-operator does everything to keep the executor in one piece, minimizing damage to the body doing the job. Rumor has it the pipeline was commissioned by Daydream Chems’ insurance arm.
monster.merc_valkyrie_squad_female.name: Valkyrie
monster.mercury_baron.desc: This creature is reminiscent of genies from ancient earth legends. Truly, shartmakhum is a mysterious and deadly Bramfatura.
monster.mercury_baron.name: Sultan
monster.mercury_head.desc: A flying head of the most nightmarish visage. Messenger of Shartmakhum, who sows death in physical reality.
monster.mercury_head.name: Malāk
monster.mercury_knight.desc: A quasimorph, ready to accept death with laughter for the glory of Shartmakhum.
monster.mercury_knight.name: Faris
monster.mercury_pact_baron.desc: This creature is reminiscent of genies from ancient earth legends. Truly, Shartmakhum is a mysterious and deadly Bramfatura.
monster.mercury_pact_baron.name: Sultan
monster.mercury_pact_head.desc: A senior Malāk of Shartmakhum, swollen with the power of oblivion that accumulates on Mercury. It hurls itself into battle to replenish the stores of void from which it draws its strength.
monster.mercury_pact_head.name: Malāk ad-Dahr
monster.mercury_slave.desc: A faithful slave of the major Quasimorphs of Shartmakhum, ready to serve his masters in war.
monster.mercury_slave.name: Abd
monster.mercury_sorceror.desc: A slave-sorcerer who counts it a joy to die once more for his Sultan—or for whoever has bound him by pact.
monster.mercury_sorceror.name: Abd as-Sihr
monster.mercury_spellsword.desc: A shield-bearing abd of Shartmakhum, armed beyond his station and stepping through space at his Sultan’s command—or at the command of the wretch who dared to bind him by pact.
monster.mercury_spellsword.name: Abd at-Turs

monster.miner_Emeraldlight_female.name: Golem

monster.miner_female.name: Miner
monster.miner_male.desc: The hard workers who ensure a constant flow of raw materials to keep the ancap system running.
monster.miner_male.name: Miner
monster.miner_PlanetBridge_female.desc: Ordinary worker bee of PlanetBridge. They dig tunnels inside the asteroids of the Belt, build stations in the orbits of the planets of the Outer System, and can re-calibrate the engine on the fly.
monster.miner_PlanetBridge_female.name: Millwright
monster.miner_PlanetBridge_male.desc: Ordinary worker bee of PlanetBridge. They dig tunnels inside the asteroids of the Belt, build stations in the orbits of the planets of the Outer System, and can re-calibrate the engine on the fly.

monster.miner_Sunlight_male.desc: Keepers of the Sunlight Coven secrets, golems are ready to rush into battle to stop anyone who tries to interfere with the interests of the corporation.

monster.miner_UnchainedBelt_female.desc: From the outside appearance of pirate spacecrafts, you wouldn't know that anyone was maintaining them, but it is the technicians who don't let them break apart into pieces.
monster.miner_UnchainedBelt_female.name: Technician
monster.miner_UnchainedBelt_male.desc: From the outside appearance of pirate spacecrafts, you wouldn't know that anyone was maintaining them, but it is the technicians who don't let them break apart into pieces.
monster.miner_UnchainedBelt_male.name: Technician
monster.mirza_aishatu_custom.desc: Your own shadow. You see Mirza Aishatu, a clone whose internal filtration systems — liver, kidneys, glands — have endured things no other living system in the universe could withstand.
monster.mirza_aishatu.desc: Your own shadow. You see Mirza Aishatu, a clone whose internal filtration systems — liver, kidneys, glands — have endured things no other living system in the universe could withstand.
monster.mirza_aishatu.name: Seal
monster.moon_baron.desc: A powerful Quasimorph of Duggur, leading his faithful servants into battle.
monster.moon_baron.name: Nobilis
monster.moon_cage.desc: A sedentary Quasimorph that is extremely hard to kill. The nightmarish creation of the surreal hell of Duggur.
monster.moon_cage.name: Triarius
monster.moon_champion.desc: A servant of Duggur entrusted with protecting his Nobilis. Thus he is shackled in even harsher discipline and flesh: harder to break, incapable of forgiveness.
monster.moon_champion.name: Lictor Lunaris
monster.moon_knight.desc: A grim warrior of the dark and mysterious Bramfatura of the Moon.
monster.moon_knight.name: Eques
monster.moon_pact_animated.desc: The Hand of the Duggur itself, clutching a weapon to turn it against the enemies of its lady.
monster.moon_pact_animated.name: Ferromaniple
monster.moon_pact_baron.desc: A powerful Quasimorph of Duggur, leading his faithful servants into battle.
monster.moon_pact_baron.name: Nobilis
monster.moon_pact_blade.desc: A two-handed sword mercenary, paid in yet another reaffirmation of his oath to his Nobilis—or to whoever that Nobilis has bound by pact.
monster.moon_pact_blade.name: Gladius Maximus
monster.moon_pact_golem.desc: A punished Nobilis of Duggur. Once a magnificent lord, now physically weakened and given the mind of a servant.
monster.moon_pact_golem.name: Steel Servant
monster.moon_pact_torture.desc: A servant sentenced to serve his Nobilis (or whoever can bind him by pact), doomed to reap life, die, and be reborn with the same purpose.
monster.moon_pact_torture.name: Custos Defixus
monster.moon_servitor.desc: A minor Quasimorph of Duggur. A faithful servant of his dark masters.
monster.moon_servitor.name: Magna Servus
monster.moon_slave.desc: An unfortunate creature of the Bramfatura of the Moon who would rather die than live. But life is his punishment.
monster.moon_slave.name: Servus Minorum
monster.niko_medich_custom.desc: Your own shadow. Before you stands an efficient and brutal blood-soaked killer, fond of stepping over the bodies of slain enemies without regard for familiar patches, names, or faces.
monster.niko_medich.desc: Your own shadow. Before you stands an efficient and brutal blood-soaked killer, fond of stepping over the bodies of slain enemies without regard for familiar patches, names, or faces.
monster.niko_medich.name: Rogue
monster.olirna_baron.desc: Lord of one of Olirna’s mountain fortresses, he still bears the body of a ruler but has been stripped of true authority. He moves like a master still, though every step is guided by a will not his own.
monster.olirna_baron.name: Dzongpon
monster.olirna_imp.desc: A lesser winged spirit of Olirna. These mad creatures never knew freedom, so the enslavement of their bramfatura changed nothing for them.
monster.olirna_imp.name: Dre
monster.olirna_mastiff.desc: Servants of Olirna, trained for the hunt and for watch duty. There is still a trace of former nobility in their soft tread, but not enough to snap the leash by which an alien will keeps them bound.
monster.olirna_mastiff.name: Gangseng
monster.olirna_monk.desc: A vow-bound servant of Olirna. Whatever dignity he once possessed has turned to blue dust. The oaths he once swore were seized by a new will and bent toward the service of an altogether different purpose.
monster.olirna_monk.name: Damtsig
monster.olirna_vizier.desc: The warlike knights of Olirna, once deemed worthy to command lesser spirits in battle. Their discipline endures, but the honor that once sustained it has been twisted, until the will of the Dapons became a mangled extension of Gagtungr’s own.
monster.olirna_vizier.name: Dapon
monster.penal_FrancheComte_female.desc: Many dangerous inmates are more than willing to risk their live for chance to earn their freedom.
monster.penal_FrancheComte_female.name: Penal Trooper
monster.penal_FrancheComte_male.desc: Many dangerous inmates are more than willing to risk their live for chance to earn their freedom.
monster.penal_FrancheComte_male.name: Penal Trooper
monster.perfect_Tianming_female.desc: Personally engineered for excellence by the corporation, sanctioned by Tianming’s Central Council.
monster.perfect_Tianming_female.name: Zhizhen
monster.perfect_Tianming_male.desc: Personally engineered for excellence by the corporation, sanctioned by Tianming’s Central Council.
monster.perfect_Tianming_male.name: Zhizhen
monster.persival_fawcett_custom.desc: Your own shadow. You see the noble figure of Percival Fawcett, ready for close combat or long-range fire alike — or to vanish forever into the depths of the dark bramfaturas.
monster.persival_fawcett.desc: Your own shadow. You see the noble figure of Percival Fawcett, ready for close combat or long-range fire alike — or to vanish forever into the depths of the dark bramfaturas.
monster.persival_fawcett.name: Paladin
monster.plb_ceo_male.desc: Every one of his structures is a eternal contract signed with blood and sweat. Believes architecture is willpower set in vacuum-hardened stone.
monster.plb_ceo_male.name: Ushijima Moromao
monster.plb_cyborg_battle_PlanetBridge.d: Created to operate in the environments even Marines can't handle, LV-426 can adapt to any situation by reconfiguring its chassis.
monster.plb_elite_female.desc: A PlanetBridge corporate-property defender. The Site Marshal leads the crew under fire, grids the defensive sector like a worksite, and turns the station into a web of load-bearing strongpoints.
monster.plb_elite_female.name: Site Marshal
monster.plb_elite_male.desc: A PlanetBridge corporate-property defender. The Site Marshal leads the crew under fire, grids the defensive sector like a worksite, and turns the station into a web of load-bearing strongpoints.
monster.plb_elite_male.name: Site Marshal
monster.pmc_female.desc: This is the same as you, an operator of some PMC. The only difference is that she works for someone else. There are no other differences.
monster.pmc_female.name: Mercenary
monster.pmc_heavy_AnCom_female.desc: While covert activities are preferred by AnCom, Warlocks are deployed when superior firepower is required.
monster.pmc_heavy_AnCom_female.name: Warlock
monster.pmc_heavy_AnCom_male.desc: While covert activities are preferred by AnCom, Warlocks are deployed when superior firepower is required.
monster.pmc_heavy_AnCom_male.name: Warlock
monster.pmc_heavy_female.desc: A heavily armed fighter from one of the many private military companies.
monster.pmc_heavy_female.name: Mercenary
monster.pmc_heavy_FrancheComte_female.de: Franche-Comte PS facilities are designed to be impenetrable, no matter if threat comes from inside or outside.

monster.pmc_heavy_male.name: Mercenary
monster.pmc_heavy_PlanetBridge_female.de: PlanetBridge deploys structuralists when stations or spacecrafts require urgent fortification or dismantling. These experts operate in zero-G and handle large-scale tools and assemblies.
monster.pmc_heavy_PlanetBridge_male.desc: PlanetBridge deploys structuralists when stations or spacecrafts require urgent fortification or dismantling. These experts operate in zero-G and handle large-scale tools and assemblies.
monster.pmc_heavy_PlanetBridge_male.name: Structuralist
monster.pmc_heavy_SBN_female.desc: They cut a Headliner loose when the station he’s headed for needs to make prime time. He works loud and spectacular—yet clean enough that it never traces back to the mogul behind SBN.
monster.pmc_heavy_SBN_female.name: Headliner
monster.pmc_heavy_SBN_male.desc: They cut a Headliner loose when the station he’s headed for needs to make prime time. He works loud and spectacular—yet clean enough that it never traces back to the mogul behind SBN.
monster.pmc_heavy_SBN_male.name: Headliner

monster.pmc_heavy_Tianming_female.name: Yongshi
monster.pmc_heavy_Tianming_male.desc: Not just a mercenary — he is sanctioned by the ancient rite, even if he once was a pirate.
monster.pmc_heavy_Tianming_male.name: Yongshi

monster.pmc_male.name: Mercenary

monster.pmc_PlanetBridge_female.name: Techcontractor

monster.pmc_SBN_female.desc: A cheap hired gun on an SBN contract. The work is real, but the employer might as well not exist. He fights through a proxy chain of proxies, often without even knowing whose interests he’s representing; the less the brand shows, the tighter SBN’s grip.
monster.pmc_SBN_female.name: Sponsored Gun

monster.prisoner_UnchainedBelt_female.de: A prisoner in the past, she is now trying to earn her freedom and a position on a pirate spacecraft.

However, the workers are deprived of their will and work for a piece of bread and a residential barrel in a capsule hotel.
